lines.text: Elisha told the woman to live as a foreigner for seven years, and she and her household did so in Philistia.
Elisha told the woman to leave because the LORD had decreed a seven-year famine, and she lived in the land of Moab.
At the end of seven years, the woman returned and went to the king to appeal for her house and land.
The king asked Gehazi to relate the great things Elisha had done, and the woman came in as Gehazi spoke of the dead raised.
The woman confirmed it, and the king appointed a priest to restore all that was hers, with the proceeds of her field.
